# Enroll Learner

## Summary
Creates an active Enrollment in a cohort.

## Refuses when
cohort closed; learner already seated; cohort full.

## Non-goals
Business rules beyond those listed belong to the consumer.

## Example
The linked cohort is the target; enrolling a learner adds a seat to it. Every enrolment that is not withdrawn holds a seat.
attributes.cardDescription: Seats a learner in a cohort as an active enrolment, refusing a closed or full cohort and a learner already seated.
